_comment: India edition of the overview PDF (marketing/brochure.pdf). No review service: Indian doctors may not ask patients for reviews (docs/STRATEGY.md). Change the words here, then: python marketing/build_brochure.py --all. Your phone and e-mail are NOT kept here (this repository is public).
